feature_design: first four levels nested; gauge is separate O(N) sufficient-orbit input in circular models
independence: each point has 5120 independent channel/data/noise frames; disjoint train/validation/test; points use distinct seeds; feature levels share identical observations
teacher_scope: exact finite QPSK Gaussian-control likelihood; public local teacher is conditional known statistical point, not unknown-nuisance deployment
information_scope: heldout score-moment plug-in lower-bound estimates with bootstrap uncertainty; not certified feature Fisher or an exact retention rate
selection: ridge chosen by validation standardized four-score MSE; test cannot select levels or transfer point
